tasks.label: Build (MSVC)
args: call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" && if not exist build mkdir build && cl /nologo /utf-8 /Zi /MD /Fe:build\game.exe /Fo:build\ /I src /I "SDL2-2.30.12\include" /I "SDL2_ttf-2.22.0\include" src\*.c src\phase1\*.c src\phase2\*.c src\phase3\*.c src\phase4\*.c /link /LIBPATH:"SDL2-2.30.12\lib\x64" /LIBPATH:"SDL2_ttf-2.22.0\lib\x64" SDL2main.lib SDL2.lib SDL2_ttf.lib winmm.lib shell32.lib /SUBSYSTEM:CONSOLE && copy /Y "SDL2-2.30.12\lib\x64\SDL2.dll" build\ && copy /Y "SDL2_ttf-2.22.0\lib\x64\SDL2_ttf.dll" build\
